scope: Two fresh-process combined clone-elision plus event-chain component replicas; not model throughput

workload.input_corpus: mutually distinct exactly representable integer-valued BF16 corpus in every one of the 40 measured epochs
workload.candidate_delta: jointly removes the production out-of-place clone and replaces ordinary XCCL submission with the guarded same-queue event chain

correctness_gate.collective_elements: bitwise exact for all 97 outputs on all four ranks in every epoch
correctness_gate.analytic_sum_oracle: control and candidate each equal an independently computed exact four-rank SUM in every epoch
correctness_gate.consumer_elements: bitwise exact for all 191 returned tensors from the 96 HC invocations in every epoch
correctness_gate.protocol_receipt: each rank's untimed Kineto trace contains Rt64_128_PCIE and does not contain the neutral Rt64_PCIE path

frozen_interpretation.both_replicas_pass: eligible for one separately preregistered full endpoint A/B; not yet a throughput claim
frozen_interpretation.any_performance_failure: close before a full model load
frozen_interpretation.abnormal_replica_exit: abort without launching the next replica and require no surviving gate or torchrun process
